label: subject pronouns: the full paradigm
note: Half real, and the half that was a measurement artefact is gone. mii and tuu/tumhii ARE taught and NOW MEASURABLE -- chapters 9 to 12 migrated to schema v2, so MR-LEX-MI and MR-LEX-TU-TUMHI exist and this note no longer needs a measurement caveat. What remains is content: the third person and the plural, to, tii, te and aamhii, occur nowhere, which is what the reading paper's person-to-detail part asks for. A paradigm missing its third person is not a paradigm.
